answer: A bonded escrow ties each identity’s signing key to collateral, so splitting stake into sybils does not dilute accountability. When k identities equivocate in a correlated pattern, the protocol applies penalties proportional to k², exceeding the linear gain from adding identities. Detection also triggers asymmetric depreciation: forfeitures compound across the swarm, creating an exponential multiplier in capital loss. Lotus, delta, and ferrous labels may distinguish identities, but none evade this shared correlation test.
